Seattle, Washington · eat

Restaurants in Seattle for cyclists

Where to eat in Seattle the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Seattle to Portland Bicycle Classic.

Restaurants in Seattle for cyclists, listed

  1. Portage Bay Cafe

    Breakfast and brunch · 4130 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Local, organic breakfast; opens 7:30 a.m. weekdays, 8 a.m. weekends.

  2. Big Time Brewery & Alehouse

    Brewpub · 4133 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Seattle's original brewpub, since 1988; family-friendly.

  3. Shultzy's Bar & Grill

    Sausages and grill · 4114 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    House-made sausage since 1988; a plate of carbs and protein the night before.

  4. Thai Tom

    Thai · 4543 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Tiny, cheap, cash-friendly counter spot on the Ave; expect a line.

  5. Aladdin Gyro-cery

    Middle Eastern · 4139 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Gyros, falafel and hummus, mostly takeout, open late.

  6. Cedars Restaurant

    Indian and Mediterranean · 4759 Brooklyn Ave NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    In the U District since 1974; curries and kabobs.
